display-md.purpose: Major section breaks, high-density page titles.

title-md.purpose: Card headers, form section legends, sidebar labels.

body-md.purpose: Default running text, form values, dialog copy.

body-sm.purpose: Secondary text, navigation labels, table cells, buttons.

code.purpose: Machine-generated identifiers: task, order, invoice numbers.

shadows.name: interactive-lift

shadows.name: dialog-overlay

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary CTA. Near-black background, white text. The signature action color.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #111111; color: #ffffff; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; padding: 12px 20px; height: 40px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #242424; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #111111; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action. White background with hairline border. Used for cancel and navigation.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: #ffffff; color: #111111; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; padding: 12px 20px; height: 40px; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #f8f9fa; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #111111; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Irreversible actions. Red background, white text. Reserved for delete and reject.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { background: #ef4444; color: #ffffff; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; padding: 12px 20px; height: 40px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: #dc2626; } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ef4444; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form input. White background, hairline border, 8px radius.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #ffffff; color: #111111; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.5; padding: 10px 14px; height: 40px; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 8px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s ease-out, box-shadow 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #111111; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(17,17,17,0.1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #898989; }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Status label. Pill-shaped, caption typography. Multiple semantic variants.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #f5f5f5; color: #111111; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge-success { background: #10b981; color: #ffffff; } .ds-badge-destructive { background: #ef4444; color: #ffffff; } .ds-badge-warning { background: transparent; border: 1px solid #f59e0b; color: #d97706; }

components.name: Data Table

components.css: .ds-table-outer { border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 16px; padding: 6px; background: #f8f9fa; } .ds-table-inner { border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 12px; background: #ffffff; overflow: hidden; } .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; } .ds-table th { background: #f8f9fa; padding: 10px 14px; text-align: left; font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; color: #6b7280; border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e7eb; } .ds-table td { padding: 10px 14px; color: #374151; border-bottom: 1px solid #f3f4f6; } .ds-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; } .ds-table tr:hover td { background: #f8f9fa; }

narrative.overview: Pabriq is a craftsman's workbench for Made-To-Order businesses. Every element earns its place. The system reads as a well-organized workshop: tools in their spots, materials visible at a glance, nothing decorative getting in the way. Confidence comes from precision, not ornamentation. The visual language is deliberately restrained. A near-monochrome palette keeps the focus on the work itself: orders, production tasks, invoices. Color appears only where it carries meaning.
keyCharacteristics: Sidebar-driven app shell with collapsible icon mode
Near-monochrome action layer — primary CTAs are #111111, not blue
Information density with clarity — double-border table pattern, kanban columns with soft backgrounds
Tactile feedback on every interaction — hover:shadow-md, button press states
Role-appropriate views — owner sees revenue, operator sees tasks, customer sees progress
Mobile-first responsive tables — data tables collapse to stacked Card layouts on mobile

rules.name: The Monochrome Action Rule
rules.body: Primary CTAs are always #111111, never blue. The only exception is destructive actions (#ef4444). Color communicates state, not brand.

rules.name: The Semantic Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Success green, warning amber, and error red appear only where they carry operational meaning. They are signals, not decoration.

rules.name: The Weight Boundary Rule
rules.body: Headlines and titles are always weight 600. Body and labels are 400 or 500. Never use 700 on display sizes.

rules.name: The Mono Identity Rule
rules.body: Monospaced text is reserved exclusively for machine-generated identifiers: task numbers, order numbers, invoice numbers.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state — hover, active press, or dialog overlay.

rules.name: The No-Glass Rule
rules.body: Glassmorphism is prohibited. The one exception is the data table refetch overlay (1px blur). Content is always opaque.

dos: Do use #111111 for all primary CTAs. The button is near-black, not blue.
Do use the sidebar as the structural backbone. Every screen starts with sidebar navigation.
Do use the double-border table container pattern for all data tables.
Do use #f8f9fa for kanban column backgrounds and sidebar background.
Do apply hover:shadow-md transition-shadow on every clickable card surface.
Do use font-mono for task numbers, order numbers, and invoice numbers.
Do use i18n keys for every user-facing string.
Do use the StatusBadge component for all status displays.
Do respect role-based visibility. Never show someone something they can't act on.
donts: Don't use blue (#3b82f6) on primary CTAs. Blue appears on less than 5% of surfaces.
Don't use glassmorphism, backdrop-blur on content surfaces, or translucent cards.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text with gradient).
Don't wrap everything in Cards. Match the container to the content pattern.
Don't use modals as the first thought for every interaction.
Don't animate CSS layout properties (height, width, padding).
Don't use console.log or code comments.
Don't hardcode user-facing text. Use use-intl and message files.
Don't guess library APIs. Check docs or existing patterns first.
